documents.title: Key Financial Highlights On Un-Audited Financial Results For Q2 FY27
Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

Board Meeting Intimation for For Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company Along With The Limited Review Report For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

Board Meeting Outcome for The Board Of The Company Has Inter-Alia Approved The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half-Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Management reported a record financial performance for FY 2025-26 driven by the commissioning of the Alu-Zinc coating line and the augmentation of the existing colour-coated line. Total revenue crossed the one thousand crore milestone, supported by volume growth across value-added coated steel products and a broader domestic sales footprint. Management highlighted a debt-light balance sheet and strong operational leverage, with profitability metrics showing significant improvement year-on-year. Looking forward, the company outlined future capacity expansions and strategic targets for revenue growth in subsequent financial years. Manaksia Steels Limited is undertaking capacity expansions including a new Alu-Zinc production line and a colour coating manufacturing line, funded through internal accruals and earnings.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new colour coating manufacturing line to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
guidance.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

guidance.claim: The new integrated Alu-Zinc production line is expected to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating line investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

demand_outlook.claim: The company noted weakened demand in the steel sector globally, leading to lower price realizations.
demand_outlook.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested H85 Crore in a new Alu-Zinc line of 110,800 TPA, funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company undertook a second expansion programme comprising a colour coating manufacturing line at a cost of H40 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line.

capex_expansion.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line will enhance the company's manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
